Array aur Linked List... dono mein data hi store hota hai. Phir interviewer kyun poochta hai, fark kya hai?
Kyunki dono ka data rakhne ka tareeka bilkul alag hai! Chalo cinema hall aur treasure hunt se samajhte hain.
Array matlab cinema hall ki ek row. Saari seats ek ke baad ek, line mein... memory mein bhi bilkul aise hi, continuous.
Seat number pata hai? Seedha wahin pahuncho! Index paanch, ek hi jump mein. Yehi hai O of one access.
Ab Linked List. Ye hai treasure hunt! Har box mein data, aur agle box ka address, yaani pointer.
Boxes memory mein kahin bhi bikhre ho sakte hain. Paanchva box chahiye? Shuru se ek-ek clue follow karo. Yaani, O of N!
Ab aaya twist! Beech mein ek naya dost aa gaya. Toh Array mein? Sabko ek-ek seat khiskna padega. O of N, poori mehnat!
Linked List mein? Bas do arrow badlo, aur naya box jud gaya. Koi shifting nahi!
Toh ek line mein yaad rakho. Array: fast access, fixed size. Linked List: easy insert aur delete, dynamic size.
Padhna zyada hai? Toh Array. Badalna zyada hai? Toh Linked List.
Interview mein ye sawaal pakka aata hai! Reel save karo, aur us dost ko bhejo jo dono ko same samajhta hai.
Aur jaate-jaate, Pretest Passed ko follow karna mat bhoolna!
